content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends specific glucose targets for individuals managing diabetes. 1. The target fasting blood glucose level should be between 63 and 140 mg/dL (3.5 to 7.8 mmol/L). 2. The goal for Time in Range (TIR) is to achieve at least 70% of glucose readings within this target range. 3. The Time Below Range (TBR), defined as glucose levels below 63 mg/dL (3.5 mmol/L), should be less than 4% of the total readings. 4. The Time Above Range (TAR), defined as glucose levels exceeding 140 mg/dL (7.8 mmol/L), should be less than 25% of the total readings.
